page.overview:
What is New Spring?

left|thumb|200pxNew Spring (abbreviated NS by fans) is a prequel novel in The Wheel of Time series. The events in the novel take place roughly twenty years before the beginning of The Eye of the World. It was published by Tor Books and released in January 2004.

New Spring was originally published in short form in the fantasy anthology Legends: Stories By The Masters of Modern Fantasy. The anthology was edited by Robert Silverberg and was released by Tor Books on September 15, 1999.

Because it is not considered part of the main Wheel of Time storyline, New Spring was not selected for [http://www.tor.com/blogs/2014/04/the-wheel-of-time-and-the-hugo-voter-packet inclusion in the 2014 Hugo Voter Packet] with the rest of the Wheel of Time series. {| cellspacing="0" cellpadding="5px" style="border:none;"

One of the most common questions for new readers is when New Spring should be read with respect to the main series books. Since it is a prequel, it obviously takes place first in the chronology of events. Robert Jordan wrote the book so that it would be possible to read New Spring without having read any of The Wheel of Time before. He clarifies in the following question posed by a fan:
